**[Suggestion]** The ~15-line chain that extracts parent tool names from `generationConfig.tools`, filters through `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS`, and deduplicates with `Set` is duplicated nearly identically here (`resolveCurrentForkRuntime`) and in `agent.ts:1684–1701` (`prepareForkSubagent`). No shared helper exists.

**Failure scenario:** A future change to the extraction logic (e.g. adding a new exclusion, handling a new tool-group shape) must be made in two places. If one site is updated and the other is not, fork launch and fork resume will silently diverge in which tools they consider available.

**Suggested fix:** Extract a shared helper (e.g. `extractParentToolNames(generationConfig)`) in `agents/runtime/agent-core.ts` next to `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS`, and call it from both sites.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** 从 `generationConfig.tools` 提取父级工具名、通过 `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS` 过滤并用 `Set` 去重的约 15 行链式调用，在这里（`resolveCurrentForkRuntime`）和 `agent.ts:1684–1701`（`prepareForkSubagent`）中几乎完全重复。没有共享的辅助函数。

**失败场景：** 未来对提取逻辑的修改（例如添加新的排除规则、处理新的工具组形态）必须在两处同步进行。如果只更新了一处，fork 启动和 fork 恢复将会静默地在可用工具集上产生分歧。

**建议修复：** 在 `agents/runtime/agent-core.ts` 中 `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS` 旁边提取一个共享辅助函数（例如 `extractParentToolNames(generationConfig)`），并在两处调用它。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

Good call — verified the duplication is real. The same derivation (flatten `functionDeclarations`, drop `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS`, dedupe via `Set`) existed in `resolveCurrentForkRuntime` here and in the fork-launch path at `packages/core/src/tools/agent/agent.ts:1684` (the `agent.ts:1684` you cited — the fork `AgentToolInvocation`, not a `prepareForkSubagent` symbol).

Extracted a shared `extractParentToolNames(generationConfig)` helper in `agents/runtime/agent-core.ts`, right next to `EXCLUDED_TOOLS_FOR_SUBAGENTS`, and both sites now call it — so a future change to the exclusion set or the extraction shape only happens once and the launch/resume tool surfaces can't diverge. Behavior is byte-identical (both call sites reach the helper only after the `systemInstruction` guard, and the helper tolerates an undefined config). `typecheck`, `eslint`, and the 265 core agent/fork tests are green.

Pushed in 4515766.

**[Suggestion]** `extractHttpStatus` and `isRecord` are duplicated character-for-character from `DaemonSessionProvider.tsx` (lines 3232–3242), a file in the same directory.

Concrete cost: two identical private copies of the same helper in adjacent files. A future change to the error-shape contract (e.g. supporting a `statusCode` field or a new SDK error class) must be made in both places independently, and a miss in one silently diverges the HTTP-status detection behavior between provider-level error handling and action-level error handling.

Suggested fix: export both helpers from a shared module in the same directory (e.g. `error-utils.ts`) and import them where needed.

建议将两个工具函数提取到同目录的共享模块中（如 `error-utils.ts`），并在需要的地方导入。

```suggestion
export type RipgrepRuntimeRecoveryFailureKind = RipgrepFailureKind;
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** The `'original content'` literal is duplicated across four sites in two test cases (lines 79, 122, 1554, 1633) with no single source of truth — Failure scenario: a maintainer changes the `createFile` initial content but forgets to update the `!==` assertion, causing the test to silently pass for any model output (false positive).

```suggestion
input.content !== INITIAL_CONTENT
```

Extract to a module-level constant (e.g. `const INITIAL_CONTENT = 'original content';`) and use it in both `createFile` calls and both `!==` assertions.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`'original content'` 字面量在两个测试用例的四个位置（第 79、122、1554、1633 行）重复出现，没有统一的来源。如果维护者修改了 `createFile` 的初始内容但忘记更新 `!==` 断言，测试将对任何模型输出静默通过（假阳性）。

建议提取为模块级常量（如 `const INITIAL_CONTENT = 'original content';`），在 `createFile` 调用和 `!==` 断言中统一使用。

</details>

**[Suggestion]** Dead assignment: `this.activeRecordId = undefined` is immediately and unconditionally overwritten by `lastRecordIdIn(snapshot.compactedTurns)` on the next line, making the reset have no observable effect. The same pattern appears in `seedReplayEvents()` at lines 320–322.

Failure scenario: A future maintainer sees the comment "Drop any previously-observed recordId anchor" and believes there is a meaningful reset-then-rescan two-step. If `lastRecordIdIn` is later refactored to be conditional, the dead `= undefined` silently becomes load-bearing — with no test asserting the reset, the change goes unnoticed.

```suggestion
    // Pre-scan seeded compactedTurns for the last recordId (mirrors
    // seedReplayEvents) so eviction by addReplaySegment doesn't lose it.
    this.activeRecordId = lastRecordIdIn(snapshot.compactedTurns);
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** 无效赋值：`this.activeRecordId = undefined` 在下一行被 `lastRecordIdIn(snapshot.compactedTurns)` 无条件覆盖，重置操作没有任何可观察的效果。`seedReplayEvents()` 的第 320–322 行存在相同模式。

失败场景：未来的维护者看到注释"Drop any previously-observed recordId anchor"会以为存在有意义的"重置→重扫描"两步操作。如果将来 `lastRecordIdIn` 被重构为条件赋值，无效的 `= undefined` 会悄悄变为有效代码——而由于没有测试断言该重置，这一变化不会被发现。

</details>
